Iris (People Ops): Quick one  manager asked to make an L2->L3 promotion effective 2026-06-01 but evidence was uploaded today (2026-06-18). Can we backdate benefits and 401k match?
Tom (Eng Manager): They hit ramp target earlier; manager wants comp and benefits aligned to 6/1.
Nina (Comp & Benefits): Base pay retro within 30 days is doable with approvals. Benefits (medical/401k match) depend on vendor rules; some vendors only allow changes at month boundaries or require enrollment windows.
Omar (Payroll): Payroll can process salary retro. For 401k match we need vendor recalculation; that creates an off-cycle employer adjustment. Need: employee_id, retro_periods, retro_amount, vendor_case.
Tom (Eng Manager): What approvals do we need from People Ops?
Iris (People Ops): Manager attestation + Sr. People Ops signoff. Attestation should be 1-2 lines confirming milestones, no prior denials, and no headcount conflicts.
Nina (Comp & Benefits): Also flag equity consequences if grant regen required; Legal may need to review for tax docs.
hr-bot: Case PO-2026-1012 opened by Iris. Attachments requested: manager_attestation.pdf, peer_feedback.txt
Tom (Eng Manager): I'll add attestation now. Any payroll template I should use?
Omar (Payroll): Sample fields we need to include in the Workday retro: `employee_id: 22211`, `effective_date: 2026-06-01`, `retro_reason: PromotionBackdate`, `journal_code: PR-401K-ADJ`. If vendor won't backdate match, we'll run employer adjustment next payroll.
Iris (People Ops): Thanks. Next steps: Tom upload attestation, Nina check vendor feasibility and Legal if needed, Omar prep payroll entry after approvals. I'll escalate to Sr. People Ops.
Tom (Eng Manager): Will notify the person with tentative timeline. Thanks all :pray:
